summary.name: Meta Developer Platform (llama.meta.com)
summary.one_liner: Meta's developer hub for its Muse model family, offering the Muse Code terminal coding agent, the Meta Model API, and related models such as SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark Open.
use_cases: Building agentic coding workflows in a terminal
Calling Muse models through an OpenAI-compatible API
Running long multi-step tasks with sub-agents
Detecting and tracking objects in images and video from text prompts
Serving open-weight models locally with SGLang, vLLM or MLX
summary.what_it_does: The page is Meta's hub for developers building with its Muse models. Muse Code is a multi-agent coding tool that runs in the terminal, with install commands shown for Mac and Windows. The Meta Model API gives direct, self-serve access to Muse models, and OpenRouter is listed as another way to use them. The model lineup includes Muse Wonder for coding and long-running agents, Muse Spark Open (described as an 816B open-weight model), SAM 3.1 for object detection and segmentation, Muse Voice Transcribe, Muse Image, and Muse Glimmer, which is available on Hugging Face. The page also links to quickstarts and cookbooks covering topics such as search grounding, computer use and subagent fan-out.
notable: Muse Code multi-agent terminal coding tool built for Muse models
Muse Spark Open is an open-weight model downloadable for self-hosting or fine-tuning
Meta Model API is OpenAI SDK compatible
SAM 3.1 segments and tracks objects in image and video from text prompts
caveats: Page does not state pricing for the Meta Model API or Muse Code plans
Listing describes LLaMA as a 65B model, but the current page centers on Muse models and does not mention LLaMA beyond documentation links
